verdict.rationale: Appwrite ships an official MCP server that lets LLMs/agents interact directly with its API and docs without managing API keys, plus an llms.txt/docs.md surface for AI consumption, enabling natural-language operation of the backend via connected AI agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability and breadth of supported natural-language operations, and any first-party chat/console natural-language interface beyond the MCP integration.
